Description: A gravel development prototype for the 2022-2024 Rally1 regulations, powered by a 380 hp 1.6 L turbocharged engine. The hybrid unit is represented by ballast only, with no electric boost. It retains the existing monocoque chassis, suspension and engine architecture to reduce development costs. Minimum weight is 1260 kg, wheelbase is approximately 2600 mm, and gravel damper travel is limited to 270 mm.
